SELECT SEQ_INSURANCE_PRODUCTS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO insurance_products (product_id, product_types, product_name, product_desc, thumbnail_url, conditions_path, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{product_type}, #{product_name}, #{product_desc}, #{thumbnail}, #{conditions}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO coverage_definitions (coverage_id, product_id, cover_name, cover_desc, coverage_amount, base_premium, cover_required) VALUES (SEQ_COVERAGE_DEFINITIONS.NEXTVAL, #{product_id}, #{cover_name}, #{cover_desc}, #{coverage_amount}, #{base_premium}, #{cover_required})

INSERT INTO premium_rate_rows (rate_row_id, product_id, age_from, age_to, gender, age_weight, gender_weight, is_smoker) VALUES (SEQ_PREMIUM_RATE_ROWS.NEXTVAL, #{product_id}, #{age_from}, #{age_to}, #{gender}, #{age_weight}, #{gender_weight}, #{is_smoker})
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_desc, p.thumbnail_url, c.coverage_id, c.cover_name, c.cover_desc, c.coverage_amount, c.base_premium, c.cover_required FROM insurance_products p LEFT JOIN coverage_definitions c ON p.product_id = c.product_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY c.coverage_id
